summary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment furnished a Form 6-K reporting that subsidiary Melco Resorts Finance Limited completed redemption of all US$600,000,000 outstanding 5.625% senior notes due 2027 on September 23, 2026, following an August 24 redemption notice. The redeemed notes represent 100% of the original aggregate principal; all were canceled, leaving none outstanding. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or equity consideration was disclosed. This is a full debt retirement, not a share buyback, reducing leverage and interest burden ahead of maturities. Watch refinancing cost, liquidity, and Macau gaming demand.
